recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 骨髓中，組織球淡染的細胞質內散佈許多大小一致、約 2–3 µm 的小圓點（中央偏下最明顯），即 LD bodies；因切片保存差與解析度限制，看不清動基體（kinetoplast）。
features: Edematous, poorly preserved marrow with vacuolated background
Histiocytes with pale, finely granular cytoplasm containing numerous uniform tiny round bodies (~2–3 µm), most evident centrally
Scattered plasma cells and lymphocytes with dense round nuclei
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei (histiocytes/precursors)
Refractile brown pigment granule in lower center (hemosiderin/artifact)
Organism internal structure (nucleus and kinetoplast) not resolved
describe_en: High-power H&E section of bone marrow biopsy shows edematous, poorly preserved marrow with histiocytes containing numerous small, uniform, round intracytoplasmic bodies measuring approximately 2–3 µm, admixed with plasma cells, lymphocytes and occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei. A refractile pigment granule is also present. The nucleus and kinetoplast of the organisms cannot be resolved on this section. Findings are suggestive of Leishman-Donovan bodies of visceral leishmaniasis in this HIV-positive patient; Giemsa staining of the aspirate, culture, or PCR should be used for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo, lack a kinetoplast, and are GMS/PAS-positive.
Talaromyces organisms are GMS-positive and show transverse septa from binary fission, relevant in HIV patients from Southeast Asia.
Cryptococcus has a mucicarmine-positive capsule with variable size, and Pneumocystis appears as extracellular foamy cysts on GMS.
Debris is heterogeneous in size and shape rather than uniform ovoid organisms.
